pull.title: feat: reference-implemented wasm + JVM provider for math/sin
pull.body:
## Summary
First **implemented** atomic capability package (with contracts#22):

- `artifacts/provider.core.wasm` (core export `sin` f32→f32)
- `:provider-status :reference-implemented` + sha256 + exports
- JVM `Math/sin` reference host helper
- 3 tests / 8 assertions

## Test plan
- [x] `clojure -M:test`

+++ b/src/kotoba/capability/math/sin/provider.clj
@@ -0,0 +1,15 @@
+(ns kotoba.capability.math.sin.provider
+  "JVM reference host provider for actor:host field \"sin\"."
+  (:import [java.lang Math]))
+
+(defn sin-f32
+  [^double x]
+  (float (Math/sin x)))
+
+(defn host-export
+  []
+  {:module "kotoba"
+   :field "sin"
+   :params [:f32]
+   :result :f32
+   :fn (fn [x] (sin-f32 (double x)))})

diff --git a/test/kotoba/capability/math/sin_test.clj b/test/kotoba/capability/math/sin_test.clj
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..dec0740
--- /dev/null
+++ b/test/kotoba/capability/math/sin_test.clj
@@ -0,0 +1,30 @@
+(ns kotoba.capability.math.sin-test
+  (:require [clojure.test :refer [deftest is]]
+            [clojure.java.io :as io]
+            [kotoba.capability.math.sin :as capability]
+            [kotoba.capability.math.sin.provider :as provider]
+            [kotoba.core.capability-repository :as repository]
+            [kotoba.core.contracts :as contracts])
+  (:import [java.security MessageDigest] [java.lang Math]))
+
+(defn- sha256-file [f]
+  (let [md (MessageDigest/getInstance "SHA-256")
+        bytes (.digest md (.readAllBytes (io/input-stream f)))]
+    (apply str (map #(format "%02x" (bit-and % 0xff)) bytes))))
+
+(deftest manifest-conforms-as-reference-implemented
+  (is (= :reference-implemented (:capability/provider-status capability/manifest)))
+  (is (= [] (repository/validate-manifest (contracts/capability-contract) capability/manifest))))
+
+(deftest artifact-sha256-matches-bytes
+  (let [path (io/file "artifacts/provider.core.wasm")
+        declared (get-in capability/manifest [:capability/artifact :sha256])]
+    (is (.isFile path))
+    (is (= declared (sha256-file path)))))
+
+(deftest jvm-reference-provider-matches-java-math
+  (let [export (provider/host-export) f (:fn export)]
+    (is (= "kotoba" (:module export)))
+    (is (= "sin" (:field export)))
+    (is (= (float (Math/sin 0.0)) (f 0.0)))
+    (is (< (Math/abs (- (double (f 0.5)) (Math/sin 0.5))) 1e-5))))
